problem_type: Document storyboard persistence accidentally creates canvas nodes
symptom: Saving or reopening an unbound document storyboard can materialize nodes without an original editor action.
direct_cause: Generic Run command and landing paths did not distinguish document author persistence from explicit original canvas actions.
class_root: Author persistence and passive reconciliation must not acquire authority to create missing document-plan nodes.
affected_population: Document storyboard Runs placed through the creation editor
Retry after renderer failure or restart
entry_points: Passive canvasLandingHost reconciliation of document Runs
Original editor actions, whose placement implementation is covered by 2026-09-20-legacy-storyboard-placement
internal_only_reason: The invariant is internal command routing and existing Run persistence, not a third-party behavior.
invariants: Document author save is pure durable persistence: no renderer placement RPC, media submission or spend authorization.
Passive reconciliation does not create an unbound document draft; existing binding/result reconciliation retains its original scope.
Original row/batch generation may materialize missing nodes on demand; explicit Place is optional, never a prerequisite for generation.
generation.present admits a precise source-bound scope without spend authority; generation.place_canvas is not an admitted command.

door_reduction.why_not: IPC payload admission, durable save reduction and existing passive landing retain distinct responsibilities. Generated door identities remain unchanged; explicit original row placement is covered by the existing legacy-storyboard-placement contract.

generality_proof: IPC/reducer save routing persists the editorial body without a placement effect; canvasLandingHost excludes passive unbound document drafts. Original editor actions retain the sole explicit placement implementation documented by the existing legacy-storyboard-placement contract.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Validate save and scope-presentation payloads; do not introduce a placement command or accept spend authority.
Return a durable author-save result without a canvas materialization effect.
Keep passive unbound document drafts off canvas while retaining existing scoped projection/reconciliation.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: generation.save_storyboard validates the complete author payload; the command allowlist does not admit generation.place_canvas.
Passive document reconciliation returns without landing when no binding exists; explicit original row actions are not routed through a replacement service placement command.

recurrence.reason: Every document save, retry and reopen can otherwise acquire an unintended materialization side effect.
same_class_scan: Read current productionRunIpc command allowlist and productionRunReducer generation.save_storyboard: no generation.place_canvas command.
Read canvasLandingHost runLanding source-document/hasCanvasBinding guard and explicit author-projection distinction.
Read explicitCanvasPlacement.test.ts: save makes zero renderer calls; placement is the original runStoryboardBatch placementOnly action and preserves overrides across reopen.

prevention.invariant: Author saves and passive document hydration do not create missing canvas nodes.
prevention.failure_mode: Invalid source/content rejects the save; unbound passive document landing returns without creating nodes.
prevention.strategy: Retain pure author-save reduction and existing document landing guard; explicit original placement is owned by the separate legacy-storyboard-placement contract, not a new service command.

legacy_paths.rationale: No replacement placement service is retained; generation.place_canvas is absent. Original row actions remain usable with or without prior explicit placement.

migration: Existing bindings and execution records remain readable; no canvasPlacement flag or new prerequisite is required. Unbound document drafts remain unmaterialized during save/reopen, while original generation can still create nodes on demand.

invariant_owner_layer.rationale: The existing Run persistence and passive landing boundaries separate author saves from original editor materialization.
